appearance_facts.location: Upper-left quadrant of the pie chart
appearance_facts.fact: A pale yellow sector labeled 'Nuclear (40%)' occupies the largest visible area of the circle.

appearance_facts.location: Upper-right quadrant of the pie chart
appearance_facts.fact: An orange sector labeled 'Fossil Fuels (15%)' is the smallest visible area of the circle.

appearance_facts.location: Lower-left quadrant of the pie chart
appearance_facts.fact: A dark red sector labeled 'Hydroelectric (25%)' is larger than the orange sector but smaller than the pale yellow sector.

appearance_facts.location: Lower-right quadrant of the pie chart
appearance_facts.fact: A salmon-colored sector labeled 'Renewables (20%)' is larger than the orange sector but smaller than the dark red sector.
The four sectors meet at a central point, with the pale yellow sector spanning the widest angle.
